title: R0_QUESTIONNAIRE — Breast Disease (pseudonymised)
description: Minimally processed pseudonymised metadata (TCode instead of StudyID, shifted dates, PII removed, letter codes as numbers) from breast_disease.json containing Benign breast disease or abnormality (up to four episodes) and other breast injury or disease, collected at baseline.

R0_BBD_Abnormality.title: Ever told by a doctor of benign breast disease or abnormality?
R0_BBD_Abnormality.description: Participant's history of benign breast disease or abnormality.
R0_BBD_Abnormality.$comment: Source coding: 0 More than one option chosen; 1 Yes; 2 No.

default: S02:p.21 Q7:4 Have you ever been told by a doctor that you have had benign breast disease or abnormality? Yes No

BBD.title: Benign breast disease episodes
BBD.description: One entry per benign breast disease or abnormality, up to 4, in the order reported; further episodes are on page 15:1 and more than four are flagged by R0_BBD_MoreThan4.

default: S02:Source question (7:4) If yes, what was the disease or abnormality?

BBD.x-universe: Only populated when R0_BBD_Abnormality = 1 (Yes); 7:4 says 'If no, go to question 7:5'.

R0_BBD_Num.title: Which benign breast disease this entry refers to (1st, 2nd, ...)

R0_BBD_Type.title: What the benign breast disease or abnormality was
R0_BBD_Type.description: Type of benign breast disease or abnormality.

default: S02:p.21 Q7:4 If yes, what was the disease or abnormality?

R0_BBD_Age.title: Age when first diagnosed (years)
R0_BBD_Age.description: Age at diagnosis of benign breast disease or abnormality.
R0_BBD_Age.$comment: The dictionary names this field R0_BBD__Age3 and R0_BBD__Age4 (double underscore) for episodes 3 and 4 [source typo]; the SchemaPropertyName R0_BBD_Age is used.

default: S02:p.21 Q7:4 How old were you when it was first diagnosed?

BBD_Extra.title: Further details of episodes 2 to 4
BBD_Extra.description: Additional benign breast disease episodes: when it happened, the age range and the procedures, as the questionnaire asks them for the 2nd to the 4th episode.
BBD_Extra.x-universe: Only the 2nd to 4th episode have it; the 1st episode is asked in a different form.

R0_BBD_FromAge.title: Start age if the diagnosis is given as a range (years)
R0_BBD_FromAge.description: Start age if diagnosis given as a range.
R0_BBD_FromAge.$comment: Episodes 2 to 4 only (the dictionary block BBD_Extra); the dictionary has no column for episode 1, which carries -999. The list of old names starts with a placeholder for episode 1 so that each name keeps its position.

R0_BBD_ToAge.title: End age if the diagnosis is given as a range (years)

R0_BBD_CystDrained.title: Procedure: cyst or fluid drained
R0_BBD_CystDrained.description: If the procedure type was cyst or fluid drained.
R0_BBD_CystDrained.$comment: Episodes 2 to 4 only (the dictionary block BBD_Extra); episode 1 carries -999 (it has the coded procedure above). The list of old names starts with a placeholder for episode 1. Source coding: 0 No; 1 Yes. The six boxes share QuestionID 1135. The dictionary names this box R0_BBD_ProcedureType2/3/4, as episode 1's coded question, and gives all six boxes the SchemaPropertyName R0_BBD_Mastec; a new name is used.

default: S02:p.21 Q7:4 A cyst or fluid drained

R0_BBD_Mastec.title: Procedure: whole breast removed
R0_BBD_Mastec.description: If the procedure type was whole breast removed.
R0_BBD_Mastec.$comment: Episodes 2 to 4 only (the dictionary block BBD_Extra); episode 1 carries -999 (it has the coded procedure above). The list of old names starts with a placeholder for episode 1. Source coding: 0 No; 1 Yes. The six boxes share QuestionID 1135. The dictionary question text of the episode 3 and 4 rows swaps this box's label with the other of the pair (whole breast removal / small sample); the old column name (brbenmastec) is followed.

default: S02:p.21 Q7:4 The whole breast removed
